title: Rock_Tunnel
lead_summary:
Rock Tunnel is a dark cavern which splits the sections of Route 10. It is initially the only way to reach Lavender Town, due to the slumbering Snorlax and the Saffron gatekeepers.
Players will want to use either the HM08 Flash or its HM Replacement Item (see List of TMs for more info) to navigate through the cavern, although it is possible without them.
On B1F, behind some breakable rocks, there is an exit which leads to a small cave with an old man with an Easter egg.
missable_warnings: NOTE: Contains actions that alter player Karma.
